Steelers owner and president Art Rooney II believes that when all is said and done, Aaron Rodgers will be back in a Steelers uniform in 2026.

“The main thing that the tender gives us is potential for a comp pick if Aaron would choose to go to another team,” Rooney II said. “We don’t expect that, but by the same token, you never know. And it’s just something that we had an opportunity to protect if needed.
